reviews.t: Best of those available in price range
reviews.x: I'm a DIY with acrylic nails.  I had a major problem with lifting.  This stopped that cold. BTW,  I work with my hands, and POWER tools.  My hands take a real beating. My nails are short, only visible from the palm, they do look lovely. No more lifting!
I love the shorter brush on this product. It makes it so much easier to apply. This product also makes a great bond. I would buy this again and recommend it to a friend.

I was using an acrylic primer and I was still experiencing alot of lifting. Once I used this, it held the gel product to my nail very well and now i can do fill ins like a normal person.I also make sure I wear gloves to wash dishes to keep my nails protected. I am not a professional I do my own gel nails to save money. This is a must have and has solved my lifting problem. I also use the IBD dehydrator to help me have maxium adhesion. good luck.

If you are doing your own nails this bonder is a must have with ibd products.  I did a lot of research when purchasing ibd products and didn't buy the bonder to begin but you must have this for the gel to set.  would reccomend the whole IBD line for all nail needs.

claims.text: Most reviewers say this bonder prevents lifting and helps gel adhere well to the nails.
Many reviewers consider it a must-have, especially when used with IBD gel products.
A few reviewers report that gel still lifts or peels even when using this product.
Reviewers praise the easy application, including the shorter brush and that a little goes a long way.
Some reviewers would buy it again and recommend it to others.
